scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty posets only; neighbourhoods and valuations are upsets.
Same-poset labelled semantic equality, not general frame isomorphism or bisimulation.
Pointwise canonical signatures need not form a persistent assignment after independent deletion.
The count \(4(n+1)^2\) is only for constant two-sided assignments on n-point chains.
Does not settle full duality, typed-semantics completeness, or infinite-frame faithfulness.
Unindexed equivalent literature, especially inaccessible older INL fragment studies, remains possible.
title: Canonical observable signatures of finite positive instantial neighbourhood frames
